VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims to have fixed the off-by-one error and achieved 44/44 passing tests, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 44 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not self-attestation. Self-reports are the weakest admissibility class and cannot independently satisfy acceptance criteria that require objective verification of test results.
